# GPT5.6 游戏自动化知识图谱

## 系统结构与数据流
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 00:05] 使用 GPT5.6  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 00:12] 脚本发送键盘按键  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 00:20] P键截图保存  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 00:28] Codex读取图片  

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    G5_6["GPT5.6"] --> SE["Script Engine"]
    SE --> KI["Keyboard Input"]
    KI --> GS["Game Screen"]
    GS --> SC["Screenshot (P key)"]
    SC --> FF["Fixed Folder"]
    FF --> CA["Codex Image Analysis"]
    CA --> ND["Navigation Decision"]
    ND --> MC["Movement Command"]
    MC --> KI
    ND --> FPS["Full Panorama Script"]
    FPS --> CA
```

## 导航流程与地图偏移处理
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 00:33] 图片理解困难  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 00:41] 45°地图偏移  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 01:01] 脚本标注截图  

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    CS["Capture Screenshot"] --> AI["Analyze Image"]
    AI --> MO["Detect Map Orientation (45°)"]
    MO --> OF["Compute Offset"]
    OF --> DD["Decide Direction"]
    DD --> SK["Send Key (↑/↓/←/→)"]
    SK --> UP["Update Position"]
    UP --> CG["Check Goal (e.g., Kitchen, NPC)"]
    CG -->|Not reached| CS
    CG -->|Reached| END["End Navigation"]
```

## GPT5.5 与 GPT5.6 的对比
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 01:14] 5.5 导航慢  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 01:17] 常找不到位置  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 05:47] 5.6 路线清晰  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 08:07] 全景拼接脚本补足空间记忆  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 09:20] 5.6 可连续运行  

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    G5_5["GPT5.5"] -->|Limited Image Understanding| SLow["Slow Navigation"]
    SLow -->|Frequent Stuck| MS["Manual Step Control"]
    G5_6["GPT5.6"] -->|Improved Image Understanding| FA["Fast Autonomous"]
    FA --> FPS["Full Panorama Script"]
    FPS -->|Enhances Spatial Memory| FA
    FA -->|Continuous Run| CR["Continuous Run without Step‑by‑step"]
    CR -->|Fewer Attempts| Better["Better Performance"]
```

## 障碍处理与决策点
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 04:35] 绿标记未被使用  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 06:07] 对话容错  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 13:41] 厨房门误识别  
[BV1Hy336wEuf P1 14:56] 接近出口但需战斗  

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    MD["Misidentified Door"] --> SA["Script Annotation"]
    SA --> GM["Green Marker"]
    GM -->|Not used| ND["No Effect"]
    ND -->|Proceed| CD["Continue Navigation"]
    CD --> NDA["NPC Dialogue Alignment"]
    NDA -->|Tolerance| Success["Successful Dialogue"]
    Success --> BF["Battle Encounter"]
    BF -->|Defeat| Exit["Reach Exit"]
```
